cover_headline: Sensex Adds 308 Points as Nifty Reclaims 23,000 in Second Straight Rally
facts: The Sensex closed 308.49 points higher at 74,459.53 and the Nifty rose 116.35 points to 23,053.10 on Friday
The Nifty IT index rose 2.3% and Nifty Pharma 1.8%, while midcap and smallcap indices fell 0.8% and 1.8%
Trent jumped 5.20% after reporting a 25% rise in quarterly net profit to Rs 468 crore

end.headline: Sensex Adds 308 Points as Nifty Reclaims 23,000 in Second Straight Rally
end.line: Two-day Sensex gains top 1,200 points as IT and pharma lead, Trent jumps 5.2% on earnings, and October snaps a two-month losing streak — even as midcaps and smallcaps fall.
